selection_method: deterministic SHA-256 ranking after model-independent eligibility screening

loader.note: M3 and M4 are loaded as the complete series representation returned by datasetsforecast 1.0.1; V2 then applies its own frozen 80/20 split.

series_fingerprint_encoding: SHA-256 of contiguous little-endian float64 series bytes
prohibition: No forecasting model may be fitted or evaluated on final_locked series before the complete Gate-2 protocol is committed and tagged.
